intro: One handful (30g) of unsalted mixed nuts has about 180 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the natural fats in nuts, so even a small portion is energy-dense.
diet: Yes, and mixed nuts are a great snack for staying full longer. There's just one problem: it's very easy to overeat when you eat straight from the jar. One handful is fine, but three handfuls in front of the TV is like a plate of rice. The key is to measure first before you eat.
tips: Pack nuts into small 30g containers for the week, keep them in your bag or office drawer.
Pick unsalted ones without honey or sugar coating.
Mix a small handful into yogurt or oats so breakfast is more filling without adding many calories.

swap.name: Boiled edamame, 1/2 cup
swap.why: About half the calories, similar or higher protein, and bigger volume so it feels like you're eating more.

faq.q: Are mixed nuts good for the heart?
faq.a: Nuts have unsaturated fats and fibre, which are good. Choose unsalted ones and eat a moderate portion. If you have health issues, check with your doctor.

faq.q: Raw or roasted nuts, which is better?
faq.a: Both are okay. Dry-roasted without extra oil has almost the same calories. Avoid ones fried in lots of oil and salt.

faq.q: When is the best time to eat nuts?
faq.a: In the afternoon between lunch and dinner, when you start getting hungry. It helps you avoid overeating at dinner.
